chain.title: Walk Where It Glows
chain.desc: The soft floor of the mod's crystal caverns; the light_the_way advancement fires the moment you set foot on it, and Spectres will only spawn on it.

chain.title: Blue Light in the Rock
chain.desc: Broken from Allurite Clusters; it fuels the Echo Bell, tempts Spectres and ties off the Rope Dart.

chain.title: The Warmer Crystal
chain.desc: Broken from Lumiere Clusters; it composts into glowstone dust and is the only accepted Monstrometer fuel.

chain.title: Throw Some Light
chain.desc: A copper ingot, a glow ink sac and a stick; fired from a crossbow it lights a stretch of cave at once.

chain.title: The Cavern Metal
chain.desc: Smelted from Palladium Ore, Deepslate Palladium Ore or Raw Palladium; in 1.5 it replaced Silver as the mod's backbone metal.

chain.title: Bench for Volatile Work
chain.desc: Palladium ingots on planks; the workstation the mod's explosive and flare recipes are built around.

chain.title: Fly Your Colours
chain.desc: Palladium and leather; it is the only helmet in the mod and the only one that will hold a banner, per its attached_sterling advancement.

chain.title: It Bounces First
chain.desc: Palladium and gunpowder; its own tooltips advertise a bounce, a fuse duration and an explosion radius.

chain.title: Counting What Lurks
chain.desc: Lumiere Shards on palladium; fed a Lumiere Shard it reads how many hostiles are near you.

chain.title: A Ghost in Glass
chain.desc: Not crafted - the watchfly advancement calls it catching a Spectre in a bottle, and the interaction lives in the Spectre entity class.

chain.title: A Scout You Can Fire
chain.desc: Palladium around a Bottle of Spectre; launched, the freed Spectre marks what it finds for you.

chain.title: Seeing Through Its Eyes
chain.desc: Made by using a spyglass on an allurite-bound Spectre, exactly as the eye_for_eye advancement describes; the interaction is in the Spectre class.

chain.title: A Fixed Point Underground
chain.desc: A palladium ingot, an echo shard and a sculk shrieker; the mod's teleport anchor, and the 1.5 replacement for the old Warped Anchor.

chain.title: The Mole Wants a Deal
chain.desc: Inserted into a Mole Burrow to open the mining-quest trade loop, per the questful advancement and the mod's MiningPouchManager.

chain.title: Paid in Flakes
chain.desc: A rare and epic reward from the Mole's mining quests; used on any sapling it turns the tree opal.

chain.title: Wood Turned to Gem
chain.desc: Cut from an Opal Log, the trunk of a tree grown from an opalised sapling; it blocks up and bricks up into its own building set.

chain.title: Cracked but Not Silent
chain.desc: Another rare and epic Mole reward; it is the ruined core the working bell is rebuilt around.

chain.title: Ring It and Listen
chain.desc: The Broken Echo Bell with an echo shard, an Allurite Shard and a stick; feeding it Allurite Shards keeps it sounding.

chain.title: Salt of the Rose Caverns
chain.desc: Broken from Pink Salt Clusters; it composts coarse dirt, becomes gunpowder and cures phantom membrane.

chain.title: The Rose Bed
chain.desc: Pressed from Pink Salt Straw; the base block of the pastel, rose, polished and brick salt families.

chain.title: Preserved in Salt
chain.desc: Phantom membrane packed with Pink Salt Shards; the salt-cured leather of the pink salt caverns.

chain.title: Reign of Terror
chain.desc: The mod's only boss, placed by its own BerserkerFeature inside the Pink Salt Shrine; it slams, roars and summons.

chain.title: Wrenched From the Berserker
chain.desc: One of the Berserker's two drops and the smithing template of the preserved transform recipe, which salts items with Pink Salt Shards.

chain.title: Salt Made Into a Weapon
chain.desc: Pink Salt Shards around Preserved Flesh and a Preserved Template; the mod's endgame item, with its own advancement for killing an Evoker with it.

notes: Item set = the 159 stems of assets/galosphere/models/item/*.json intersected with item.galosphere.* / block.galosphere.* keys in assets/galosphere/lang/en_us.json; every id above is in that set except the one allow-listed id below. The mod adds no dimension - it is overworld cave content - so there are no dim: steps. MAJOR CONSENSUS CONFLICT - SILVER WAS RENAMED TO PALLADIUM. moddb's Galosphere list is built on 1.3.x/1.4.x packs and leads with galosphere:silver_ingot (0.000), galosphere:silver_bomb (0.514), galosphere:silver_ore (1.000) and galosphere:warped_anchor (0.157). None of those ids exist in 1.5.2. Diffing the 1.4.1 Forge jar against 1.5.2 gives the exact rename set: removed were silver_ingot, silver_ore, deepslate_silver_ore, raw_silver, raw_silver_block, silver_block, silver_nugget, silver_bomb, silver_lattice, silver_panel(+slab,stairs), silver_tiles(+slab,stairs), silver_balance, warped_anchor, barometer, charged_lumiere_block and pink_salt_chamber; added were palladium_ingot, palladium_ore, deepslate_palladium_ore, raw_palladium, raw_palladium_block, palladium_block, palladium_nugget, palladium_dust, palladium_bomb, palladium_lattice, palladium_panel(+slab,stairs), palladium_tiles(+slab,stairs), burrow_anchor and the whole opal, echo bell, mole and mining-pouch layer. Read silver_* -> palladium_*, warped_anchor -> burrow_anchor. galosphere:barometer (moddb pos 0.822) and galosphere:charged_lumiere_block are gone with no replacement id; the Monstrometer survives and is the surviving detector. Only leftover silver textures, sounds and two dead smithing_template.silver_upgrade lang keys remain in 1.5.2. If the pack pins Galosphere 1.4.1 instead, invert the mapping above. ALLOW-LISTED ID: galosphere:preserved_template (moddb pos 0.683) has an item model, is an entry in data/galosphere/loot_tables/entities/berserker.json, and is the template of both preserved_transform_recipe.json and saltbound_tablet.json - but its display name lives under upgrade.galosphere.preserved_upgrade rather than item.galosphere.<id>, so it fails a naive model-intersect-lang test. It is real and it is the gate for the endgame item. DROPPED, UNVERIFIABLE: galosphere:shrine_key is registered in GItems, has a lang key and a texture and is the sole entry in loot_tables/spawners/pink_salt_shrine/key.json, but it has no item model json at all in 1.5.2, so it fails set membership and was left out. ENTITY CHECK: 14 entity.galosphere.* lang keys, of which 6 have loot tables (berserker, mole, preserved, sparkle, specterpillar, spectre). The other 8 are projectiles and props (glow_flare, spectre_flare, palladium_bomb, rope_dart, pink_salt_pillar, pink_salt_shard, spectator_vision, weapon_rack). Only kill:galosphere:berserker is used; it is the one true boss, its loot table is the only source of preserved_template and preserved_flesh, and net/orcinus/galosphere/world/gen/features/BerserkerFeature.class places it inside the Pink Salt Shrine structure, so it is reachable without a summon item. Structures verified from worldgen/structure/: forgotten_ruins (archaeology, thirst and wave pottery sherds) and pink_salt_shrine (chest loot plus the Berserker). Mole trading verified from loot_tables/gameplay/mining_quests/{requests,gifts}/{common,rare,epic}.json - epic requests ask for lumiere_shard, pink_salt_shard and raw_palladium and pay out opal_flakes, broken_echo_bell, palladium_bomb and the faith armour trim template.
